arxiv-1905-12145.title: Optimal approximation for unconstrained non-submodular minimization
arxiv-1905-12145.creator: Marwa El Halabi, Stefanie Jegelka
arxiv-1905-12145.description: Abstract Submodular function minimization is well studied, and existing algorithms solve it exactly or up to arbitrary accuracy. However, in many applications, such as structured sparse learning or batch Bayesian optimization, the objective function is not exactly submodular, but close. In this case, no theoretical guarantees exist. Indeed, submodular minimization algorithms rely on intricate connections between submodularity and convexity.

arxiv-2204-07355.title: Visualization of nuclear many-body correlations with the most probable configuration of nucleons
arxiv-2204-07355.creator: Moemi Matsumoto, Yusuke Tanimura
arxiv-2204-07355.description: Abstract A method to visualize many-body correlations using the information of the full wave function is presented. The set of nucleon coordinates which maximizes the square of the wave function, that is, the most probable spatial configuration of nucleons, is visualized.

arxiv-2305-02107.title: Locosim: an Open-Source Cross-Platform Robotics Framework
arxiv-2305-02107.creator: Michele Focchi 1, 2, *, Francesco Roscia 1, 3, *, Claudio Semini 1
arxiv-2305-02107.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Michele Focchi 1, 2, *, Francesco Roscia 1, 3, *, Claudio Semini 1. The architecture of a robotics software framework tremendously influences the effort and time it takes for end users to test new concepts in a simulation environment and to control real hardware. Many years of activity in the field allowed us to sort out crucial requirements for a framework tailored for robotics: modularity and extensibility, source code reusability, feature richness, and user-friendliness.

arxiv-2411-13589.title: Bicomplex Mittag-Leffler Distribution
arxiv-2411-13589.creator: Dharmendra Kumar Singh, Chinmay SharmaDepartment of MathematicsSchool of Basic Sciences, UIETCSJM University, KanpurEmail: drdksinghabp@gmail.com
arxiv-2411-13589.description: Abstract Abstract Probability distribution theory helps in studying the impact of various dimensions in life while the Mittag-Leffler function and bicomplex are used in electromagnetism, quantum mechanics, and signal theory. Considering the importance of both, the purpose of this paper is to introduce bicomplex Mittag-Leffler distribution theory with the help of the bicomplex Mittag-Leffler function.

pmc-11626719.title: Human mitochondrial peroxiredoxin Prdx3 is dually localized in the intermembrane space and matrix subcompartments
pmc-11626719.creator: Fernando Gomes, Helena Turano, Luciana A Haddad, LuisES Netto
pmc-11626719.description: Peroxiredoxin 3 (Prdx3) is the major sink for H2O2 and other hydroperoxides within mitochondria, yet the mechanisms guiding the import of its cytosolic precursor into mitochondrial sub-compartments remain elusive. Prdx3 is synthesized in the cytosol as a precursor with an N-terminal cleavable presequence, which is frequently proposed to target the protein exclusively to the mitochondrial matrix.

pmc-12593137.title: Epidemiology of Epileptic Spasm and Affecting Factors on One-Year Prognosis: A Study in Tabriz Children’s Hospital
pmc-12593137.creator: Shahram Sadeghvand, Ali Kamali, Mirhadi Mousavi, Majid Mahallei, Shadi Shiva, Amin Magsudy, Fatemeh Ahmadi Hajkolaie, Gisou Erabi, Amirhosein Dadashzadeh Asl
pmc-12593137.description: Objectives:Epileptic Spasm (ES) is a special type of convulsive disorder that primarily occurs in infants, typically within the first year of life. This disorder is usually resistant to routine anticonvulsant drugs. This study aims to evaluate the epidemiology and factors affecting one-year prognosis in patients with ES in Tabriz Children’s Hospital.

pmc-12620790.title: Mesonephric-like adenocarcinoma presenting with malignant peritonitis and suspected to originate from the fallopian tube: A case report

pmc-12620790.description: BACKGROUNDMesonephric-like adenocarcinoma (MLA) is a rare and highly malignant disease that occurs in the uterine body or ovaries. Cancerous peritonitis was suspected.

pmc-13146343.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A2283 IMPROVING DETECTION OF APHASIA AND SPATIAL NEGLECT: TWO-CENTER PROSPECTIVE VALIDATION OF A DUAL-PURPOSE NIHSS ITEM 9

pmc-13146343.description: Background and aimsThe National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale (NIHSS) is central to acute stroke assessment but underrepresents right-hemisphere deficits such as spatial neglect (SN). pmc-13264104.title: Inorganic thermoelectric thin films: From synthesis to application
pmc-13264104.creator: Teng Wang, Fan Sun, Jae Sung Son
pmc-13264104.description: SummaryThermoelectric technologies constitute a sustainable paradigm for waste heat recovery. Inorganic thermoelectric thin films, leveraging low-dimensional transport phenomena and tunable physical properties, have emerged as premier candidates for flexible, miniaturized electronics. This review introduces various fabrication methodologies—including atomic layer deposition, molecular beam epitaxy, chemical vapor deposition, magnetron sputtering, and solution-based processing—elucidating their operational principles, comparative advantages, and inherent limitations.

pmc-13351121.title: Mechanical Remodeling and Mechanosensing after Spinal Cord Injury: From Molecular to Translational Approaches
pmc-13351121.creator: Jier Ma, Xiumei Tang, Jie Tan, Baoshuai Bai, Sen Guo, Shenghui Shang, Zhaoliang Hou, Yixiao He, Zhengdong Zhang, Wenzhao Wang, Zhijian Wei
pmc-13351121.description: Spinal cord injury triggers a profound, spatiotemporally dynamic remodeling of the local mechanical microenvironment. Acute tissue softening and extracellular matrix degradation give way progressively to chronic fibrotic stiffening and dense matrix cross-linking. This pathological transformation establishes a formidable physical barrier to axonal regeneration while simultaneously disrupting the biomechanical signals that normally guide cellular behavior and maintain tissue homeostasis.

pmc-13541070.title: Risk Factors for Amisulpride-Associated Hyperprolactinemia: Gender-Specific Plasma Concentration Cutoffs Derived from ROC Analysis
pmc-13541070.creator: Hui Wang, Qing Shao, Miaomiao Yang, Yichen Chen, Wenjie Wang
pmc-13541070.description: PurposeTo investigate independent risk factors for amisulpride-induced hyperprolactinemia (HPRL), establish gender-stratified diagnostic cutoff values for HPRL, and determine amisulpride plasma concentration cutoff values for different genders, thereby providing a basis for personalized medication.Patients and MethodsThis retrospective study included 209 patients treated with amisulpride. Significant univariate variables were entered into multivariable linear regression to identify independent predictors.

pmc-13592841.title: Simotang oral liquid alleviates functional dyspepsia-related motility dysfunction through Ca2+-dependent smooth muscle contraction and Nrf2/NF-κB modulation
pmc-13592841.creator: Guo Mao, Chunxiang He, Jiaqin Liu, Dahua Wu, Puhua Zeng, Ye Mao
pmc-13592841.description: Functional dyspepsia (FD) is a disorder of gut–brain interaction involving heterogeneous motor, sensory, immune, and oxidative stress-related mechanisms. Simotang oral liquid (SMT), a traditional Chinese medicine formulation used for dyspeptic and gastrointestinal motility-related symptoms, has not been evaluated with an integrated clinical, functional, and molecular framework.

(a) Deposit insurance (1) Insured amounts payable (A) In general The Corporation shall insure the deposits of all insured depository institutions as provided in this chapter.
